comment: Manual rocalc → iRO overrides for entries the automated matcher in cmd/build-rocalc-mapping can't resolve. Keys are rocalc IDs as strings; values are iRO IDs. The notes field documents the source / reasoning per group.

notes.auto_disabled_dispLoc_999: rocalc marks ~100 m_Item rows as not-selectable via the dispLoc=999 sentinel (Breeze Whip 495, Affection Staff 1672/1673, Sapha/Nab/Ur/Peuz/Wing renewal sets, Bible Promise volumes, Driver Band, etc). The mapper auto-detects this and buckets those rows alongside excluded_items; they're in rocalc's data file for legacy reasons but never appear in any UI dropdown, so the orchestrator can't ask the shim to equip them. cmd/build-rocalc-mapping/main.go reads dispLoc from m_Item[1] and sets rocalcEntry.Disabled when it equals 999.
notes.manual_review_2026-04-28: Hand-verified manual matches via rms item-page lookups (item-id=N&ird=1). Effects-confirmed when rocalc effects align with rms script; excluded when rocalc carries outdated stats vs the iRO item or when the row is server-custom. Adds: Desert Wind 817 → 13035, Ring of Money Spirit 867 → 5207, Anklet 878 → 2737, Tendrilion Skin 996 → 2544, Dark Knight Type-A real items 1050/1051/1052 → 5482/2779/2780 (1053 stays excluded as set-bonus synthetic), Magician Figure 1119 → 2768, Flower Fairy 1181 → 5437, Necromancer Hood 1204 → 5502, Red Marcher Hat 1214 → 5654, Anubis Hat 1258 → 5490, Pinwheel Hairpin 1349 → 5285, Drooping Lif 1350 → 5253, Grey Beanie 1357 → 5076, White Drooping Cat 1365 → 5058, Songkok 1386 → 5354, Siege Crown 1429 → 5834, Evolved Small Ribbons 1439 → 5221, Red Navy Beret 1525 → 5773, Gozarian Mask 1562 → 5475, Jet-black Ribbon 1831 → 5765, Hatred of Thanatos Mask 1836 → 5789. Excludes (server-custom or rocalc-outdated stats vs current iRO item): 826, 879, 880, 1012, 1018, 1027, 1206, 1229, 1535, 1628, 1632, 1809, 1835, 1854, 1855, 1857.
notes.battlefield_BF_items: Battlegrounds gear ('Brave X' / 'Valorous X' rocalc names) maps to AegisName pattern 'BF_<Type>1' or 'BF_<Type>2'; the trailing 1/2 swaps between Brave/Valorous depending on weapon class. Each pair verified individually via rms searches like /index.php?iname=brave+assassin.
notes.card_localization_2026-04-27: More pre-re MVP card matches: Super Picky ↔ Picky_Egg_Card (4011, same effects per rms; rocalc doesn't carry plain Picky Egg Card so it labels its row 'Super Picky'); Hellhound ↔ Hell_Poodle_Card (4437, Hell Poodle is the alt-monster-name for Hellhound, mob_id 1866).
notes.effect_match_2026-04-27: Mappings confirmed by exact rocalc-effect-pair to Hercules-script alignment. Effect codes derived from already-matched items: 1=bStr, 2=bAgi, 3=bVit, 4=bInt, 5=bDex, 6=bLuk, 8=bHit, 9=bFlee, 10=bCritical, 12=bAspdRate, 13=bMaxHP, 14=bMaxSP, 19=bMdef, 51/56=bAddRaceTolerance, 73=bVariableCastrate, 75=bHPrecovRate, 76=bSPrecovRate, 220=skill-grant. Confirmed by effect-match: 449 Christmas Ring → 2636 Gold_Ring_, 952 Rope of Balance → 1980 Whip_Of_Balance, 956 Shining Bulb Hairband → 5310 Bulb_Hairband, 1015 Coca-Cola Can → 5434 Cola_Can, 1044 Scarves → 5322 Scarf, 1059 Poring Cake Hat J → 5487, 1070 Sakura Mist Cap → 5523, 1196 Eyeball Ring → 2783 Eyes_Stone_Ring, 1257 Sphinx Helm J → 5494 Spinx_Helm_I, 1269 Angel of Ghost → 5389 Angel_Spirit, 1346 Vacation Hat_ → 5456, 1355 White Mage Hat → 5027 Wizardry_Hat, 1361 White Deviruchi Hat → 5228, 1405 Advanced Mini Propeller → 5226 Mini_Propeller_, 1424 Flying Angeling → 5334 Angeling_Wanna_Fly, 1430 Flying Angel Wing_ → 5269 Flying_Angel_, 1837 Cherry Crown → 5768 Sakura_Coronet (duplicate-mapping with rocalc 1579; same iRO item, different rocalc rows).
notes.enrich-mapping-rms_2026-04-27: Auto-merged 5 item + 0 card suggestions where rms returned a single candidate whose AegisName matched the rocalc name (with spaces→underscores, plus _Card suffix for cards).
notes.exclusions_server_specific: rocalc IDs intentionally NOT mapped to any iRO id, deferred to per-server-profile customization once that layer exists. Categories: (1) cards/items rocalc tags '(aRO)/(bRO)/(iRO)/(fRO)'; server-regional variants with their own effect tweaks; (2) renewal-era items rocalc lists but pre-re iRO doesn't ship (Kafra Blossom 4991 etc.); (3) NPC-only / quest-only variants (Beelzebub NPC Card); (4) items with placeholder names like '[Color] Ribbon' or '+ Puffing Fish' (rocalc-internal templates / synthetic combos); (5) Boyfriend/Girlfriend/Recruiter promotion items, Coca-Cola family beyond the basic Cola_Can, Frist Hat/Sword (typo for First? unclear); (6) Dark Knight Type B variants (1306-1311); Type A series' (1050-1053) and Type B follow the same pattern as Set entries (rocalc emulates a multi-piece combo as a single row).
notes.exclusions_server_specific_mobs: rocalc mob rows that don't correspond to any iRO mob; server-custom variants (One/Two-Horn Scaraba '(Custom)' / '(aRO)' rebalanced versions, BG NPCs Crystal/Food Storage/Guardians used only inside Battlegrounds maps, [Custom Player] template, aRO-suffixed CG MVPs that have iRO-canonical siblings already mapped). Future server profiles can re-introduce these with their own iRO-id mappings.
notes.manual_review_mobs_2026-04-28: Hand-verified rocalc → iRO mob mappings via ratemyserver.net /index.php?page=mob_db&mob_id=N lookups for the 40 entries auto-disambig couldn't resolve. Pattern groups: WoE Guardians 1285-1287; Mushroom [Thief Test] (1182, mob_id 78); Cookie [Red] (1246, COOKIE_XMAS; Christmas Cookie variant rocalc relabels); Goblin [Axe/Flail/Dagger/Hammer/Morning Star] → GOBLIN_3/2/1/4/5 (1124/1123/1122/1125/1126); Kobold [Axe/Hammer/Morning Star] → 1133/1134/1135; Petite [Sky/Earth] → 1156/1155; Whikebine Tres → 1653 (Wickebine Tres in Hercules); CG MVP variants (370-375) → 1646-1651 (Lord Knight Seyren et al as CG MVP-version sprites, distinct from the 'Lv99' rebalances which are excluded); Archdam_G → 1684; Dimik [Neutral] → 1669; Ferus/Acidus/Plasma color variants → 1713-1717; Photon Cannon [Red] → 1664; Incarnation of Morroc [Angel/Golem] → 1922/1923; Memorial Dungeon mobs Thorn of Bone/Purity (1958/1961), Entweihen Knothen (1957), Skeggiold [Black/Blue] Slave (1763/1764), Baphomet [Sealed Shrine] (1929).
notes.exclusions_2026-04-28_mobs_manual: Additional hand-verified mob exclusions: 149 Picky [Super] (rocalc-internal super-monster variant, no iRO canonical); 394 Gate Controller (server-internal NPC); 497-502 CG MVP [Lv99] variants; rocalc-custom Lv99 rebalances of the canonical CG MVPs (370-375); 504 Barricades (Memorial Dungeon barricade NPC, not a real mob target); 547 Emperium [iRO] (regional variant of basic Emperium 1288 already excluded as server-custom; Emperium itself isn't a meaningful PvM scoring target).
notes.manual_review_2026-04-27: Hand-resolved no_aegis_match cases from cmd/build-rocalc-mapping/rms_suggestions.json where rocalc name and Hercules AegisName diverge but refer to the same item: word-reordering (Life Ribbon ↔ Ribbon_Of_Life, Belt Scarf ↔ Scarf_Belt), 'Hat'↔'Cap' (Amistr Hat ↔ Amistr_Cap), 'Band'↔'Hairband' (Bunny Band variants), localization (Dumpling Kid card ↔ Rice_Cake_Boy_Card).
notes.medal_of_honor_BG: Medal of Honor (X) (ATK); Battlegrounds class-medal accessories. AegisName 'Medal_<Class>'. iRO IDs 2720-2725 verified via /index.php?iname=Medal+of+Honor. (rocalc tags '(ATK)' to indicate which calc bucket the item feeds.)
notes.mvp_cards_2026-04-27: Pre-re MVP cards rocalc names where rms searches fail because the iRO display Name diverges. Verified by scanning Hercules pre-re card entries: Baphomet Jr. ↔ Baphomet__Card (4129, double underscore in AegisName), Beelzebub ↔ Berzebub_Card (4145, alt-Latin spelling), Incantation Samurai ↔ Incant_Samurai_Card / 'Samurai Spector Card' (4263), Ninetails ↔ Nine_Tail_Card (4159), Taoist Hermit ↔ Tao_Gunka_Card (4302), Clock Tower Manager ↔ C_Tower_Manager_Card / 'Tower Keeper Card' (4229), Valkyrie Randgris ↔ Randgris_Card (4407), Whikebine Tres ↔ Whikebain_Card / 'Wickebine Tres Card' (4348), Errende Ebeece ↔ Erend_Card / 'Errende Ebecee Card' (4349).

notes.soda_promo_items: Coca-Cola Can (1015) ↔ Cola_Can / 'Coca-Cola Bottle' (5434, both have no script bonuses; confirmed by effect-match). Crab Nipper Hairpin (1127) ↔ Forceps_Hairpin / 'Crab Nipper Hat' (5473, Hairpin/Hat divergence). NOTE: Coca-Cola Cap (1018) was previously mapped to Coke_Hat (5435) on display-name similarity but reverted; rocalc effects [bStr+1] don't match Coke_Hat's actual script (bInt+1, bMaxSP+80, bMdef+3); they're different items.
notes.stilleto_typo_6: rocalc 'Stilleto' is a typo for 'Stiletto' (rocalc/Hercules transposition is edit-distance-2 by Levenshtein, missed by our distance-1 fuzzy). iRO 1216 verified via ratemyserver.net /index.php?iname=Stiletto.
